text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Post time was drawing near, so I was about
to call out to Durandal, but—
choice_data_list: (I can sense something like a huge blade on the other side of the door...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: ...I feel like I can almost see the holy sword right there.
...I feel like I can almost see the holy sword right there.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. But during the race,
my own body, my very legs become the holy sword.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
All who dare stand in my way
shall be swept aside by my run.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Victory for my master.
I pray that you bear witness.
